source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Note the date, time, and location of the failed checks.
3. Record the specific sections or components that failed the inspection.
4. Document the names and contact details of the inspector and the person in charge of the building.
5. Describe in detail the specific violations or issues found.
6. Note any immediate safety hazards and indicate whether they have been mitigated.
7. Record any advised actions or rectifications needed.
8. Indicate if there was any follow-up arranged and any deadlines for corrective actions.
9. Attach photographs or notes from inspections if available for visual documentation.
10. Save a copy of the report for records and send a copy to relevant parties including the building owner, safety authorities, or insurance company if required.
11. Follow any regulatory procedures for reporting failed fire safety checks, including notifying local fire departments or safety regulators.
